summary: Verified admin-controllable 'Accueil' (visible_home) toggle for taxi service categories — both backend and frontend pass end-to-end. Final state restored: airport=OFF.
critical_code_review_comments: service_categories.py: seed migration uses HOME_DEFAULT_KEYS only on docs missing the field — correct & idempotent.
POST /admin/service-categories/{key}/toggle-home is protected by require_role(['admin'], permission='server.settings.edit') — auth verified (401 when unauthenticated).
UserHome.js taxiTiles fallback to first 7 active when no category has visible_home=true — sensible safety net.
Pre-existing console noise ignored as per request: duplicate React 'key=/login' warning, intermittent 401 polling, Google Maps deprecation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin toggle, client reflection, /taxi hub regression, no overlay)

seed_data_creation: None. Default seed already in place: 17 categories, 7 default visible_home keys (standard, pool, moto, electric, book_later, rental, intercity).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has POST /api/admin/service-categories/{key}/toggle-home and PUT /api/admin/service-categories/{key} (accepts visible_home). Pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_service_categories_home.py — all 6 pass. Home grid testids: service-svccat-<key>-btn, service-more-taxi-btn. Admin home toggle: svc-cat-home-toggle-<key>. Final state: airport visible_home = OFF (canonical 8-tile Home: standard, pool, moto, electric, book_later, rental, intercity + Tous les Taxis).

verification_evidence.GET /api/service-categories: 200, 17 categories, all with boolean visible_home, defaults match HOME_DEFAULT_KEYS
verification_evidence.Admin UI toggle airport ON: orange toggle, toast 'Affiché sur l'accueil', persists on reload
verification_evidence.Admin UI toggle airport OFF: toast 'Retiré de l'accueil', tile disappears from /home (back to 8 tiles)
verification_evidence./taxi hub regression: All 17 modes listed (mode-select-* testids) regardless of Accueil toggle
verification_evidence.Runtime errors: 0 page errors, no 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay
